description: This file contains functions to create and populate various types of USP (User Services Platform) records including WebSocket, MQTT, STOMP, UDS, and Disconnect records. It serializes these records using protobuf and prepares MTP (Message Transfer Protocol) items for transmission.

methods.name: void USPREC_WebSocketConnect_Create(char * cont_endpoint_id,mtp_send_item_t * msi)
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket connect record, serializes it into protobuf, and prepares it for transmission.

methods.name: void USPREC_MqttConnect_Create(char * cont_endpoint_id,mqtt_protocolver_t mqtt_version,char * agent_topic,mtp_send_item_t * msi)
methods.description: Creates an MQTT connect record with specified protocol version and topic, serializes it, and prepares for transmission.

methods.name: void USPREC_StompConnect_Create(char * cont_endpoint_id,char * destination,mtp_send_item_t * msi)
methods.description: Creates a STOMP connect record with specified destination, serializes it, and prepares for transmission.

methods.name: void USPREC_UdsConnect_Create(char * cont_endpoint_id,mtp_send_item_t * msi)
methods.description: Creates a UDS connect record, serializes it, and sets it up for sending.

methods.name: void USPREC_Disconnect_Create(mtp_content_type_t content_type,char * cont_endpoint_id,uint32_t reason_code,char * reason_str,mtp_send_item_t * msi)
methods.description: Creates a disconnect record with specified reason and content type, serializes it, and prepares for transmission.
